scope: Phase/clip slots and read-only rendering. No new character art or canon certification.

checks.name: Eight distinct sequence slots are supported without changing the 21 ordinary states/actions
Intro ticks use the current round countdown and restart at round boundaries
First-round loss stays reversible despite zero life and a KO actor
Reaching match point does not start a final defeat before the round countdown ends
Draw and malformed winner values never nominate the second player
A pending conclusion suppresses the ordinary final presentation
Only the declared winner object with the correct slot can conclude
Final victory flows to a separate outro slot, without extending the combat state
Reduced motion, NaN and extreme ticks cannot advance or overflow a sequence
A lethal final clip is not reused as a first-round loss
All 346 identities and eight sequence contexts stay read-only
Current art contains no newly invented sequence clips
Resident Evil transitions do not fall back to CODEC, FOX or CQC archive themes
Source integration uses the same phase mapper and guards both conclusion entry points
Runtime contract covers the new main-controller dependency, with catalog and journal unchanged
Workshop supports search, selected state, stepping and no-result safely
Workshop pause and persisted-page restoration own a single render loop
